exposure.needed: whether the operator filters cert-manager log lines with grep or similar text matching on the old log format

consequence.statement: Some cert-manager log lines have changed format because more structured logging information was added, so log filtering with grep or similar tools may no longer match as before.
consequence.remediation: Check any grep-based or text-based log filters against the new log line format.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to some log lines, so those lines have a new format and log filters that use grep or similar tools may stop matching.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The change is to the format of log output. No subject family covers log output, and the evidence does not say which components or log lines changed.
